title: com.matrixmedia.stream
description: State event representing an active MatrixMedia stream in a Matrix room. State key is the empty string (single-stream-per-room in v1). When the stream ends, the bot sets content to {} to clear the state.

oneOf.description: Active stream. All required fields must be present when a stream is running.

stream_id.description: Unique stream identifier (UUID v4, lowercase hex with dashes).

media_type.description: Primary media type of the stream. Phase 1 supports 'audio' only; 'video' and 'screen_share' are reserved for Phase 2+.

title.description: Human-readable stream title displayed in widgets and bot messages.

host_user_id.description: Fully-qualified Matrix user ID of the stream host (e.g. '@alice:example.org').

sfu_url.description: WebSocket URL of the SFU (LiveKit) server handling this stream's media.

mm_server_url.description: Base URL of the MatrixMedia server managing this stream. Used by SDKs for server discovery from room state.

participant_count.description: Current number of participants (host + viewers). Updated periodically by the server; may lag slightly behind real-time.

started_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the stream started.

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 for this version of the event schema.

oneOf.description: Cleared state. An empty object signals that no stream is active in this room.
